newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains firm as stg slips, volume low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains firm as stg slips, volume low.

text.p: LIFFE wheat pushed higher after sterling slipped against the mark.
But volume was limited. "The market did nothing all morning, then rose when sterling went down," one trader said.
November dominated with 267 of a total 381 lots. It put on 1.45 stg, to last trade at 83.35 stg, its day's high.
Barley also rose, with November 1.45 higher at 78.50 stg. November volume was 40 lots of a total 55 on barley.
Good weather has enabled British farmers to make progress with the barley crop and some even started on wheat over the weekend.
But until more detailed information on the crop is available, the market lacks the impetus necessary to get it out of the grip of sterling, traders said.
Physical markets too were quiet and driven by sterling, while most market players sat on their hands and awaited a better picture of the crop, traders said.
